name: Reverse Curl
summary: A curl with an overhand grip that works the forearm muscles and the brachialis. Use lighter weights than with an underhand curl.
setup: Hold a barbell or EZ bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with the bar at thigh level, elbows tucked to your sides.
Keep the wrists straight and the abs braced.
execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending the elbows while keeping the wrists in line.
Squeeze at the top without letting the wrists bend back.
Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.
Keep the torso still on every rep.
mistakes: Letting the wrists collapse backward: use a lighter load and keep the knuckles in line with the forearms.
Swinging the body: slow the tempo and brace the core.
Elbows drifting forward: keep them pinned to the torso.
Using too heavy a bar: choose a weight you can control for all reps.
